blocks.text: Watch a video about Configuring Sandbox Policy Rules including Advanced Policy Settings.

On the Advanced Policy Settings page for the Sandbox policy, you can add custom MD5 hash values to the denylist for your organization to block specific files that are applicable to Zscaler Sandbox analysis. You can also add custom MD5 hash values to the allowlist to allow specific files access.
To add a custom MD5 hash to the allowlist:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Cyberthreat Protection > Policy > Sandbox Behavioral Analysis.
On the Advanced Policy Settings tab, for Allow List, paste or enter your custom MD5 hash value and click Add.
(Optional) To add a comment to a URL, enter two forward slashes (//) after each URL entry. Separate each entry by pressing Shift+Enter.
Click Save and activate the change.

blocks.text: To add a custom MD5 hash to the denylist:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Cyberthreat Protection > Policy > Sandbox Behavioral Analysis.
On the Advanced Policy Settings tab, for Deny List, paste or enter your custom MD5 hash value and click Add.
(Optional) To add a comment to a URL, enter two forward slashes (//) after each URL entry. Separate each entry by pressing Shift+Enter.
Click Save and activate the change.

blocks.text: To remove a custom MD5 hash from the allowlist or denylist:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Cyberthreat Protection > Policy > Sandbox Behavioral Analysis.
On the Advanced Policy Settings tab, click the Delete icon next to the specific value.
Click Remove All to delete all the custom file MD5 hashes from the list.
Click Save and activate the change.
